title: Universal search
transcript: Press / or Ctrl+K on any page to open universal search.
Recent searches and suggestions appear before you type.
Type a market, exchange, sector or company. Results are grouped by kind.
Arrow keys move through results; Enter opens one.
A ticker works too: here is Reliance on NSE.
No match? Search suggests the screener, markets and collections instead.
